name: m4-typeparams-final-symops
description: [retronym/scala#208](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/208): `Symbol.typeParams` final, with `SynchronizedSymbols` overriding only its slow path, and `isRawIfWithoutArgs` skipping `typeParams` for initialized non-Java classes, against its base on `2.13.x`.

`SymbolOpsBenchmark`, one workload per column, over the classes of a scala corpus compile done in setup. In the base build's kperf profiles (`m4-symops-pilot`) `Symbol.typeParams` is 2.2% (`findMember`), 2.2% (`overridingPairs`) and 3.5% (`subst`) of cycles inclusive, against 0.83% in a typer-only compile of the scala corpus (`m4-symfinal-typer-kperf`). The callers are the typer's (`NoArgsTypeRef.isHigherKinded`, `TypeRef.relativize`, `AsSeenFromMap.correspondingTypeArgument`) except `isRawIfWithoutArgs`, which these workloads barely reach, so this measures the first commit.
Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26, 8G heap, no profiler. Warmup from `m4-symfinal-symops`, which plateaus by its fifth warmup iteration.
